reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Removed `istiod-remote` chart in favor of `helm install istio-discovery --set profile=remote`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: Helm installations referencing the istiod-remote chart must migrate to helm install istio-discovery --set profile=remote before upgrading to 1.24.0.

proposed.statement: The istiod-remote Helm chart has been removed; use helm install istio-discovery --set profile=remote instead.
